name: Alchemy
description: Gild a rose, then brew it: health potions that heal at once. Four gold ingots around a rose at the bench make a Golden Rose; a water bottle and one to three of them make a Weak Health Potion, a Health Potion or a Strong Health Potion, healing 4, 6 or 8 hearts and leaving the bottle.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
